component.description.BasicReader: Ingests text, code, PDF, DOCX, CSV, and Excel files
component.description.HTMLReader: Downloads and ingests HTML from a URL, with optional recursive fetching.
component.description.UpstageDocumentParseReader: Uses the Upstage Document Parse API to convert documents into structured HTML format
component.description.AssemblyAIReader: Uses the AssemblyAI API to import multiple file types such as plain text and documents
component.description.GitReader: Downloads and ingests all files from a GitHub or GitLab Repo.
component.description.UnstructuredReader: Uses the Unstructured API to import multiple file types such as plain text and documents
component.description.FirecrawlReader: Use Firecrawl to scrape websites and ingest them into Verba
component.description.OllamaEmbedder: Vectorizes documents and queries using Ollama. If your Ollama instance is not running on {{dynamic}}, you can change the URL by setting the OLLAMA_URL environment variable.
component.description.WeaviateEmbedder: Vectorizes documents and queries using Weaviate's In-House Embedding Service.
component.description.OpenAIEmbedder: Vectorizes documents and queries using OpenAI
component.description.GoogleEmbedder: Embeds and retrieves objects using Google's text-embedding-preview-0409 model
component.description.UpstageEmbedder: Vectorizes documents and queries using Upstage Solar Embeddings
component.description.VoyageAIEmbedder: Vectorizes documents and queries using VoyageAI
component.description.SentenceTransformersEmbedder: Embeds and retrieves objects using SentenceTransformer
component.description.CohereEmbedder: Vectorizes documents and queries using Cohere
component.description.MarkdownChunker: Split documents based on markdown formatting using LangChain
component.description.HTMLChunker: Split documents based on HTML tags using LangChain
component.description.CodeChunker: Split code based on programming language using LangChain
component.description.SemanticChunker: Split documents based on semantic similarity or max sentences
component.description.RecursiveChunker: Recursively split documents based on predefined characters using LangChain
component.description.TokenChunker: Splits documents based on word tokens
component.description.SentenceChunker: Splits documents based on word tokens
component.description.OllamaGenerator: Generate answers using Ollama. If your Ollama instance is not running on {{dynamic}}, you can change the URL by setting the OLLAMA_URL environment variable.
component.description.OpenAIGenerator: Using OpenAI LLM models to generate answers to queries
component.description.GroqGenerator: Generator using Groq's LPU inference engine
component.description.GeminiGenerator: Generator using Google's Gemini 1.5 Pro model
component.description.AnthropicGenerator: Using Anthropic LLM models to generate answers to queries
component.description.NovitaGenerator: Using Novita AI LLM models to generate answers to queries
component.description.UpstageGenerator: Using Upstage Solar LLM models for advanced text generation
